three_level_differences.interpretation: Descriptive three-level shape comparison only. No Richardson fit, convergence-order claim, or automatic pass criterion is applied to D2/D1 or cosine.
three_level_differences.statistics: At each of 4 times × 6 fields, compute owner-masked RMS(D1), RMS(D2), max-absolute(D1/D2), RMS ratio RMS(D2)/RMS(D1), and spatial cosine dot(D1,D2)/(||D1||2 ||D2||2). Each field retains its own units; cosine and RMS ratio are dimensionless. If either vector norm is zero, cosine is null and explicitly reasoned.
